formulas.name: The callout
formulas.example: If you still keep your policy documents in a drawer only you know about, stop.
formulas.trap: Talking down to your own readers.

formulas.name: Real dilemma
formulas.template: {A specific situation with a real cost}. What would you do?
formulas.example: Your parents ask you to pay their hospital bill and your wedding is in 6 months. What would you do?
formulas.trap: A question with one obvious answer.

formulas.name: The list
formulas.template: {N} things I wish I knew before {milestone}.
formulas.example: 5 things I wish I knew before my first CPF top-up.
formulas.trap: Promising more than 10. Nobody believes 15 good ones.

hooks.text: If you still split sales chats and tasks, stop. Meet ActivityTracker.
Lead waits in WhatsApp; your task is elsewhere. What would you do?
Things to know before managing sales follow-ups in one place.
